data engineering foundations  

data governance \& platform stewardship  

ai \& automation enablement  

devops \& platform enablement  

design, build, and operate batch and streaming data pipelines on modern cloud data platforms.  

develop robust etl/elt processes using sql, python, and pyspark with strong error handling, monitoring, and cost awareness.  

implement layered / medallion data architectures and analytics\-ready data models to support bi and ai workloads.

reliable, scalable data pipelines and data products support business reporting, analytics, and ai initiatives.

**department**


globus systems operations **about the department**


globus (www.globus.org) is a sustainable, non\-profit unit within the university of chicago delivering solutions to the research community worldwide. globus develops and provides critical services that support scientific research for governmental, academic, and commercial organizations in a wide range of disciplines including life sciences, physics, and astronomy. we develop and operate commercial\-quality, cloud\-based software application and platform services used by 10s of thousands of researchers to manage their large–and growing–data management challenges. we have offices located at the nbc tower in the heart of downtown chicago and remote employees who work\-from\-home. globus, together with globus labs, a research group within the university of chicago, and part of the data science and learning division at argonne national labs, develop and deploy cutting edge technologies to solve new challenges facing the scientific community and enable break\-through scientific discoveries. **job summary**


the globus operations team is a 4\-5 person group that designs, builds, and operates the cloud infrastructure behind a research\-computing platform used by hundreds of institutions worldwide. globus is a hybrid solution combining aws\-hosted orchestration services with installable applications, delivering identity and access management, data transfer and sharing, and task automation as both software\-as\-a\-service (saas) and platform\-as\-a\-service (paas).  

  

as a senior member of this small, high\-autonomy team, you will ensure software development and operational best practices are effectively integrated across our services and aws infrastructure. the team owns an unusually broad estate — an aws organization of roughly thirty production accounts, a golden\-image pipeline producing around thirty machine images, a self\-hosted monitoring platform, a centralized security\-logging pipeline, and in\-house compliance and security automation — all managed as code in python, bash, terraform, cloudformation, and ansible. you will work both collaboratively and independently on complex issues and projects, in some cases making progress under minimal guidance. you will also embed with select software engineering teams to provide operational and infrastructure guidance on best practices.  

  

we are looking for a senior engineer equally comfortable improving a build pipeline and debugging a production incident, and who will be a leader and educator both within and across teams.**responsibilities**

* monitoring and observability: maintain the current monitoring and alerting systems (self\-hosted nagios/nrpe with configuration generated from live aws inventory, cloudwatch alarms, pagerduty routing) and help in the migration to prometheus.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**about nexus**
---------------


you don't have an ai story if you don't have your data story. that's where nexusone comes in.

  

we're the converged data platform for the ai era — composable by design, built on an open\-source foundation, and ai\-native from the ground up. one identity, one governance envelope, one operational layer across every mainframe, data lake, warehouse, and streaming system in the business. for the first time, enterprises can bring their existing stack along instead of rebuilding it — and still give ai agents full context across the estate.

  

what we stand for is simple: sovereign data, interoperable systems, decoupled intelligence — delivered the way modern software should be. no rip\-and\-replace. no multi\-year transformation. our ceo anu jain puts it well: we turn the "ball of yarn" of data integrations into a unified engine — less like assembling car parts, more like buying the car ready to drive. 85\+ open\-source tools pre\-integrated. ai\-native automations that deploy and self\-heal the stack without human toil. forward\-deployed engineers who build shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customer teams — hands on keyboards, not just on decks.

  

it's working, and fast. we're tripling revenue year over year, backed by insight partners, and running in production in environments most vendors won't touch. our platform processes credit risk data for 90%\+ of us small businesses — 40m\+ — every month. intent signals for 300m\+ subscribers monthly for africa's largest telco. the data and ai layer for a top 3 us bank.

  

we're 100\+ people across the us and india, headquartered in atlanta. we think big, move fast, and don't mistake activity for progress. we hire people who'd rather ship the rocket than brief someone on it.


check out this podcast of anu talking about our solution here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=g8g50sv5ghq

**the opportunity**
-------------------


we are looking for a forward deployed engineer (fde) to embed with strategic enterprise customers after the sale and turn ambitious platform commitments into production outcomes.


this is a hands\-on engineering role—not a traditional consulting, project management, or customer success position. you will work directly inside complex customer environments to understand business and technical goals, design the right solution, write production\-quality code, deploy and integrate nexusone, and help customer teams operate it successfully. you will move between a customer's architecture room, a codebase, a kubernetes cluster, and an executive status discussion without losing the thread.


our customers often operate large, regulated data estates with strict requirements around security, governance, resilience, performance, and data sovereignty. their environments may span legacy platforms, cloud data systems, mainframes, warehouses, lakehouses, and ai applications. the work is rarely turnkey. you will own hard implementation problems through resolution while turning what we learn in the field into reusable product capabilities, automation, and delivery playbooks.


you will partner closely with forward deployed engagement managers, solutions architects, product engineering, customer reliability engineering, and customer technical teams. the engagement manager owns the delivery program; you own the engineering build.

**what you will do**
--------------------

### **deliver enterprise solutions**

* embed with strategic customers from post\-sale discovery through production rollout, stabilization, and knowledge transfer
* translate business outcomes and ambiguous customer requirements into clear technical designs, milestones, and working software
* design, build, test, and deploy customer\-specific integrations, data pipelines, platform extensions, migration utilities, and ai\-enabled workflows
* integrate nexusone with existing enterprise systems across identity, security, governance, data catalog, storage, compute, orchestration, observability, and ci/cd
* support migrations and modernization across on\-premises, private\-cloud, public\-cloud, and hybrid environments
* establish production\-readiness criteria covering performance, reliability, security, disaster recovery, monitoring, and operational ownership

### **engineer in the customer environment**

* write production\-quality code in languages such as python, java, scala, or go
* deploy and troubleshoot distributed systems on kubernetes using infrastructure\-as\-code and modern delivery practices
* diagnose issues across application code, data pipelines, networking, iam/rbac, certificates, storage, compute, and customer infrastructure
* lead technical workstreams during high\-severity deployment issues, communicate hypotheses clearly, and drive fact\-based root\-cause resolution
* produce high\-quality technical artifacts: architecture diagrams, design documents, implementation plans, runbooks, test plans, decision logs, and post\-incident reviews
* work effectively within enterprise controls such as architecture review boards, security assessments, change\-management processes, and production\-access policies

### **build customer capability**

* pair with customer engineers and architects so they understand the solution and can operate it independently
* lead technical workshops, design reviews, whiteboarding sessions, and hands\-on enablement
* communicate trade\-offs and risks clearly to engineers, architects, delivery leaders, and executives
* build trusted relationships while maintaining scope discipline and making realistic technical commitments
* create a clean handoff to customer reliability engineering and support when the solution moves into steady\-state production

### **improve the product and the motion**

* bring structured field feedback to product and engineering: recurring deployment friction, integration gaps, reliability issues, and product opportunities
* distinguish one\-off customer requirements from patterns that should become product capabilities
* convert repeated work into reusable connectors, reference architectures, deployment automation, tests, templates, and playbooks
* contribute improvements to the core platform when the right solution is product\-level rather than customer\-specific
* help define what world\-class forward\-deployed engineering looks like at nexusone as the function scales

**what success looks like**
---------------------------

**in the first 90 days:**

* build working knowledge of the nexusone architecture and deployment model
* establish credibility with an assigned enterprise customer and the internal engineering team
* take ownership of a defined technical workstream and ship it into a customer environment
* produce clear, reusable documentation that reduces dependence on individual engineers

**within 6–12 months:**

* lead major technical workstreams from design through production adoption
* reduce time\-to\-value for customer deployments while improving quality and predictability
* enable customer teams to operate delivered solutions with decreasing day\-to\-day dependence on nexusone fdes
* turn field lessons into reusable automation, product improvements, and delivery patterns
* protect product engineering focus by resolving customer implementation work within the forward\-deployed organization and escalating only true product issues

**who you are**
---------------

### **required**

* 6\+ years of professional software, platform, data, or infrastructure engineering experience, including substantial hands\-on ownership of production systems
* experience in a customer\-facing post\-sales, professional services, solutions delivery, consulting engineering, resident engineering, or forward\-deployed role—or equivalent experience working directly with enterprise users
* strong programming and software engineering fundamentals, with production proficiency in at least one backend language such as python, java, scala, or go
* experience with modern data infrastructure and distributed systems, such as spark, trino/presto, iceberg, kafka, airflow, dbt, data lakes, or cloud data platforms
* strong kubernetes and container experience, including deployment, troubleshooting, configuration, networking, observability, and operational readiness
* working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (aws, azure, or gcp) and infrastructure\-as\-code practices such as terraform
* ability to troubleshoot across system boundaries and stay accountable until the underlying problem is understood and resolved
* experience navigating large\-enterprise constraints such as security reviews, iam/rbac, private networking, compliance controls, change management, and multiple stakeholder groups
* excellent written and verbal communication; able to explain complex technical decisions precisely to both engineering and executive audiences
* high agency, sound judgment, low ego, and comfort operating in ambiguous environments where the playbook is still being built
* willingness to travel to customer sites as engagements require

### **strong differentiators**

* deep experience with one or more of kubernetes, spark, trino, iceberg, airflow, ranger, keycloak, datahub, terraform, dbt, airbyte, fivetran, or adjacent technologies

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**about amplify**


amplify helps teachers bring delight and rigor to students every day. we have become a leader in k–12 literacy, biliteracy, math, and science by building inspiring teaching and learning experiences based on research. the amplify classroom platform combines curriculum, assessment, and supplemental learning into one coherent high\-quality instructional system. a pioneer in education since 2000, amplify has developed deep relationships in states and districts by partnering with educators to drive implementation quality and improved outcomes. today, amplify serves more than 18 million students and teachers across all 50 states and on six continents. for more information, visit amplify.com.


we are hiring a senior data scientist for our sales analytics team. you will own sales forecasting and champion data\-driven decision making across our sales organization. day\-to\-day, that means analyzing sales trends, building models that predict sales across product lines and regions over different time horizons, and turning those forecasts into recommendations for revenue and planning decisions.


you will report to our data science manager and work on a scrum team with analytics engineers and data analysts, shipping data products end\-to\-end. you will participate directly in decisions across the data stack, from planning how source data is modeled to innovating on solutions for the sales team.

**essential responsibilities****:**

* **develop sales forecasting excellence:** by building statistical and machine learning models that meet forecasting needs across business domains. contribute to self\-service analytics and data tools so that our business partners can get answers without waiting on the team.
* **own the end\-to\-end machine learning lifecycle:** scoping, feature engineering, model training and testing, deployment, monitoring, and explainability.
* **drive strategic business partnerships:** translate model outputs into actionable recommendations for business leaders, including which drivers move the sales forecast and by how much.
* **provide technical leadership:** mentor junior data scientists, lead technical design reviews and learning sessions, and help shape the team's roadmap and standards.

**required qualifications:**

* 5\+ years of experience in a data science role, with 3\+ years focused on sales forecasting, demand forecasting, or revenue analytics. a graduate degree in a science or other quantitative field (e.g., computer science, economics, math, physics, statistics) may count toward 2 of the 5 years.
* expert user of python or r for data analysis tasks (data cleaning, manipulation, analysis).
* expert knowledge of time series forecasting methods, e.g., arima, prophet, lstm.
* proficiency with sql for data analysis tasks.
* proficient in training and evaluating the performance of machine learning models using industry\-standard libraries like pytorch, scikit\-learn, tidymodels, and xgboost.
* proven track record of developing and implementing machine learning pipelines running in production environments like aws sagemaker, databricks, or snowflake.
* demonstrated application of software development methodology and protocols, including version control and testing.
* excellent communication skills in writing and conversation, especially with non\-technical partners.
* experience driving self\-directed projects and working cross\-functionally.
* experience mentoring other data scientists or leading technical discussions.

**preferred qualifications:**

* experience working with snowflake.
* experience with container technologies, e.g., docker and kubernetes.
* background in education or in edtech.

*amplify is an equal opportunity employer. amplify makes employment decisions based on qualifications and merit, and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic or status.*

*if you are selected for employment, a background check will be required. as required by state and local laws and district policies, you may be required to provide additional documentation, such as proof of vaccination, or submit to enhanced background screening, such as fingerprinting.*

*amplify is an e\-verify participant.*

title: Data Science Senior Associate - Marketing Analytics
description:
**job description**  

  

  

you will join a collaborative team that applies advanced modeling, machine learning, and applied ai to profile clients across all lines of business, improve customer experience, and enable business performance at scale. you will take on the toughest analytical challenges the team faces—from customer segmentation to digital marketing to ai\-enabled and agentic alert systems—and turn them around with speed and rigor. you will work on high\-visibility initiatives, partner closely with business and technology teams, and help move ideas from concept into implemented solutions embedded in day\-to\-day workflows. you will also have opportunities to grow through mentoring, training, and mobility.


as a data scientist associate senior at jpmorganchase within the consumer \& community banking data and analytics organization, you will operate as a senior technical contributor and force\-multiplier for the team. you will independently own end\-to\-end modeling solutions—framing ambiguous problems, building and validating models, and driving them into production—while helping set technical direction and elevating the work of others. you will ensure solutions are statistically sound, aligned to business objectives, delivered quickly, and integrated into business processes to drive adoption and measurable impact.




**job responsibilities**

* own the team's highest\-priority modeling problems end to end, framing ambiguous questions and delivering rigorous solutions on tight timelines
* design, build, validate, and deploy advanced models spanning customer segmentation, digital marketing, and ai\-enabled and agentic alert systems
* translate business objectives into well\-scoped modeling problems with clear success criteria and measurable outcomes
* apply machine learning, statistical, and mathematical methods to develop novel solutions—including unsupervised methods such as pca and k\-means, supervised methods such as regression, tree\-based models, and gradient\-boosted algorithms, as well as causal inference, forecasting, and simulations
* build applied ai and agentic solutions, including large language model\-based systems, prompt engineering, and developer and ai assistants
* serve as a technical lead on complex workstreams, helping direct and prioritize team efforts and unblocking others
* communicate results, insights, and recommendations clearly to business stakeholders, technology partners, and senior leadership
* partner with data science, engineering, product, and design teams to ensure solutions are feasible, scalable, and production\-ready
* mentor and guide teammates on modeling approaches, code quality, and analytical rigor
* manage multiple engagements by prioritizing work, tracking dependencies, and escalating risks and tradeoffs proactively




**required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* formal training or certification on data science concepts and 3\+ years applied experience
* undergraduate degree in a quantitative discipline or equivalent practical experience
* strong programming skills in python, including the modern data science and machine learning ecosystem
* deep machine learning expertise across the full model lifecycle—feature engineering, training, validation, deployment, and monitoring
* strong statistical and mathematical foundation, with the ability to select and apply the right technique to novel and ambiguous problems
* applied ai engineering experience, including building large language model\-based and/or agentic solutions and prompt engineering
* proficiency with sql and data querying at scale
* demonstrated ownership mindset and ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast\-moving problem spaces
* strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with experience communicating effectively with both business and technology audiences, including senior leadership
* ability to guide, mentor, and influence teammates and cross\-functional partners




**preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* graduate degree (master's or phd) in a quantitative discipline
* experience in financial services or retail banking
* experience with modern data platforms such as snowflake or databricks
* experience productionizing models and integrating them into business workflows
* familiarity with experimentation, model lifecycle management, and machine learning operations practices


**about us**  

  

  

chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of america's households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. we also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs.


we offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. those in eligible roles may receive commission\-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. we also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. these benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on\-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.


we recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. we are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. we also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. visit our faqs for more information about requesting an accommodation.


equal opportunity employer/disability/veterans

  

  

  

**about the team**  

  

  

our consumer \& community banking division serves our chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. we're proud to lead the u.s. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.  

  

the ccb data \& analytics team responsibly leverages data across chase to build competitive advantages for the businesses while providing value and protection for customers. the team encompasses a variety of disciplines from data governance and strategy to reporting, data science and machine learning. we have a strong partnership with technology, which provides cutting edge data and analytics infrastructure. the team powers chase with insights to create the best customer and business outcomes.

title: Applied AI Scientist
description:
lumen is the trusted network for the ai‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. we enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and ai workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.


at lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.


this is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. the work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. if you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of ai‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**the role**
------------



lumen is seeking a highly technical and execution\-oriented applied ai scientist to design, develop, deploy, and optimize ai\-powered solutions that solve meaningful business challenges. in this role, you will partner with business, product, engineering, and technology teams to identify opportunities, rapidly prototype solutions, and deliver production\-ready ai capabilities.


you will combine expertise in machine learning, generative ai, software development, and experimentation to create scalable ai systems that improve customer experiences, operational efficiency, and business outcomes. the ideal candidate is a hands\-on builder who enjoys solving complex problems and translating emerging ai technologies into measurable business value.

**the main responsibilities**
-----------------------------


* design, develop, and deploy ai and machine learning solutions from proof of concept through production.
* partner with business and product stakeholders to identify use cases, define objectives, and measure impact.
* build solutions leveraging machine learning, generative ai, retrieval\-augmented generation (rag), nlp, predictive analytics, and agentic workflows.
* develop and maintain evaluation frameworks to ensure solution quality, accuracy, reliability, and performance.
* collaborate closely with engineering teams to operationalize ai solutions using mlops and llmops best practices.
* contribute reusable code, tools, models, and frameworks that accelerate ai adoption across the enterprise.
* stay current on emerging ai technologies and recommend innovative approaches to business challenges.
* contribute to technical best practices and knowledge sharing across the team.
**required qualifications**
---------------------------


* 3\+ years of experience in applied ai, machine learning, data science, or a related field.
* experience developing and deploying production ai or machine learning solutions.
* strong expertise in machine learning, statistics, predictive modeling, experimentation, and analytics.
* experience building solutions utilizing llms, rag architectures, vector databases, and modern ai frameworks.
* proficiency in python and common ai/ml toolsets such as pytorch, tensorflow, hugging face, langchain, mlflow, or similar technologies.
* experience working with cloud platforms and production software environments.
* strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
* experience working in cross\-functional agile teams.

**preferred qualifications**

* master's degree or phd in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, statistics, or a related quantitative discipline.
* experience implementing responsible ai and ai governance practices.
* experience supporting enterprise\-scale ai initiatives.
* contributions to publications, patents, open\-source projects, or professional ai communities.

maximus is currently seeking a senior performance engineer.
  
  

the senior performance engineer leads performance engineering activities across large\-scale healthcare technology programs. this role defines performance test strategies, develops and maintains performance testing frameworks, creates realistic workload models, and evaluates application scalability, reliability, stability, and capacity. the engineer partners with development, architecture, devops, cloud engineering, database administration, product, and business teams to identify bottlenecks, determine root causes, recommend corrective actions, and validate improvements. the role also establishes performance engineering standards, integrates performance validation into ci/cd pipelines, mentor other engineers, and communicates technical and business risks to stakeholders.
  
  

this is a remote position.
  
  

**essential duties and responsibilities:**  

* lead the development of software solutions that will meet or exceed business requirements which includes; designing and implementing modules to the system specifications, conducting unit testing, troubleshooting issues, and producing detailed proposals to resolve issues.
* evaluate new coding techniques, tools, modules, and implement as appropriate.
* consult on requirements elicitation and definition.
* design software solutions per systems requirements.
* code software solutions per designs.
* code reviews, unit test, and integrate coded modules.
* assist other developers in resolving issues by providing guidance and training.
* support testing and remediate defects.
* support users through troubleshooting and analysis of production logs and data.
* investigate new solutions, tools, products, and techniques to incorporate into coding standards.
* may provide guidance, coaching, and training to other employees within job area.


**job\-specific essential duties and responsibilities:**  

* lead performance testing activities including planning, workload modeling, test design, scripting, execution, analysis, reporting, and stakeholder communication.
* partner with business and technical stakeholders to establish, refine, and validate non\-functional requirements (nfrs) and performance service level objectives, ensuring response time, throughput, concurrency, scalability, availability, resilience, and capacity targets align with business and operational needs.
* design and execute load, stress, spike, endurance, scalability, and capacity testing scenarios.
* develop realistic workload models based on business transactions, production usage patterns, and projected growth.
* plan performance test environments, monitoring and observability requirements, test data strategies, and distributed load generation approaches.
* analyze performance metrics, logs, traces, and monitoring data across applications, databases, infrastructure, jvms, containers, and cloud platforms to identify bottlenecks and root causes.
* provide actionable recommendations to improve system performance, scalability, reliability, and resource utilization.
* establish performance baselines and identify performance regressions across releases.
* design, develop, and maintain performance testing frameworks, automation utilities, ci/cd integrations, and cloud\-native testing capabilities supporting aws services, kubernetes clusters, docker containers, helm deployments, and microservices architectures.
* participate in architecture and design reviews to identify performance, scalability, and nfr testability risks early in the development lifecycle.
* mentor engineers on performance engineering methodologies, tools, and best practices.
* evaluate and recommend emerging performance engineering, observability, and ai\-enabled testing solutions.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
description:
**devops engineer**


amplifire is seeking a devops engineer who enjoys improving real\-world systems, reducing operational friction, and delivering meaningful outcomes. this role is ideal for someone who values practical solutions over theoretical perfection and takes pride in making steady, measurable improvements to how software is built, deployed, and operated.


as part of the operations team, alongside other devops engineers, our dba, and our sys/network administrator, you'll work closely with engineering teams to improve and modernize our infrastructure and delivery processes. we're actively investing in how software is delivered and operated, with initiatives focused on deployment modernization, automation, infrastructure standardization, and reducing operational burden across the engineering organization.


our environment is evolving, and this role focuses on making it better through thoughtful, incremental changes that increase reliability, reduce risk, and simplify day\-to\-day work.


we're looking for someone who can take ownership of problems, work effectively in a collaborative environment, and consistently turn ideas into delivered outcomes. success in this role requires balancing long\-term improvements with immediate needs, focusing on changes that provide real value rather than chasing idealized end\-state architectures.

**key responsibilities**

* design, implement, and continuously improve ci/cd pipelines and deployment processes to reduce manual effort, increase reliability, and lower deployment risk. (currently jenkins, evolving toward github actions)
* identify opportunities to automate and standardize infrastructure management through practical tooling and infrastructure as code practices when they provide measurable operational value.
* support and evolve our containerization strategy as part of broader efforts to improve deployment consistency, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* partner closely with developers to simplify release workflows, improve development experience, and eliminate operational friction.
* collaborate with operations team members to strengthen platform resilience, observability, and production reliability.
* participate in release management and production support, helping ensure safe deployments and rapid resolution of issues.
* investigate production challenges and identify practical automation or process improvements to prevent recurrence.
* break down complex initiatives into achievable steps and deliver incremental improvements that create measurable value.
* contribute to technical discussions by identifying risks, proposing solutions, and constructively challenging assumptions when needed.
* evaluate and introduce tools and practices where appropriate—but with a focus on solving real problems rather than adopting technology for its own sake.
* contribute to a culture of collaboration, shared ownership, and continuous improvement across the engineering organization.


requirements:
**qualifications**

**required**

* 7\+ years of total it or software engineering experience, including at least 4 years in a devops, infrastructure, or automation\-focused role.
* strong experience with ci/cd concepts and tooling (jenkins, github actions, or similar).
* hands\-on experience with infrastructure as code tools such as terraform.
* experience working with aws services across compute, storage, networking, and monitoring.
* working knowledge of containerization technologies such as docker, ecs and kubernetes.
* strong scripting or programming skills (python, java, or shell).
* demonstrated ability to independently drive technical work and deliver measurable improvements.
* experience collaborating closely with developers to improve deployment, release, and operational workflows.
* strong communication skills and the ability to build trust across teams.
* comfort working in environments with evolving priorities, competing demands, and a mix of project and operational responsibilities.

**preferred**

* experience supporting enterprise saas applications in production environments.
* experience improving or modernizing existing infrastructure or deployment processes while maintaining production stability.
* familiarity with monitoring and observability platforms (cloudwatch, prometheus, grafana, datadog).
* exposure to security and compliance frameworks (soc 2, fedramp, iso 27001\).
* experience with agile, devops, and devsecops practices.

**what success looks like**


in the first year, successful candidates will:

* reduce deployment complexity, manual steps, and operational friction across the platform.
* improve deployment reliability, visibility, and overall confidence in releases.
* deliver incremental improvements that create measurable value for both engineering teams and the business.
* help move key infrastructure and delivery improvements from idea to implementation.
* strengthen collaboration with developers and operations by building trust and improving shared workflows.

**salary**  

$130,000 \- $145,000, depending on experience

title: Data Platform & Cloud Engineer, AI- Enabled Developer
description:
welcome to the liberty company—a forward\-thinking, rapidly growing insurance brokerage built on a foundation of culture and collaboration. recognized for our award\-winning workplace, we believe in creating opportunities for every employee to discover their *joy of being* (*job*).
our entrepreneurial, wellness\-focused environment is paired with competitive compensation, a generous benefits package, paid time off, and unique programs to support your professional and personal growth.
we’re seeking a talented data platrform \& cloud engineer, ai\-enabled developer to join our vibrant team. if our values resonate with you, and you’re looking for a workplace where culture comes first, we can’t wait to get to know you!**job summary**
the data and development engineer will own the health of our data warehouse and azure cloud infrastructure while building the next generation of internal tools using ai\-assisted development practices. this role sits at the center of how liberty turns raw operational data — from our agency management systems, carrier feeds, and finance platforms — into trusted, well\-governed information that powers reporting, dashboards, and emerging internal applications across the brokerage. the role also administers a portion of liberty's azure subscription — the cloud foundation for our internal operating and ai platforms — and leads the retirement of the legacy systems those platforms replace.
the ideal candidate is equally comfortable administering a sql server data warehouse and using modern ai coding assistants to design, build, and ship production\-grade internal applications faster than traditional development allows. this is not an ai or machine\-learning research role — it is a software engineering and data infrastructure role for someone who has made ai\-assisted coding a core part of how they build software.**key responsibilities****data warehouse, database \& cloud platform administration*** own the health, performance, and security of liberty’s sql server / azure sql data warehouse infrastructure, including production and reporting databases.
* administer, monitor, and tune database environments: indexing, query performance, backup and recovery, capacity planning, and patching.
* build, maintain, and monitor the etl/elt pipelines that pull data from source systems — agency management systems, carrier and finance platforms, hr/payroll, and other line\-of\-business tools — into the warehouse.
* design and maintain data normalization, transformation, and modeling logic so downstream reporting and bi tools work from a single, consistent source of truth.
* manage schema changes, data quality checks, and job orchestration/scheduling for recurring data loads; troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and data discrepancies.
* define and enforce data access controls, retention practices, and documentation standards for the warehouse, in coordination with it and compliance.
* collaborate with it department team members and conform to liberty's governing technology policies — including security, change management, access provisioning, and architecture standards — across all warehouse, cloud, and application work. this role carries a dotted\-line reporting relationship to technology operations.
* partner with the bi/analytics team to expose clean, well\-modeled data sets to existing and future consumption layers, including dashboards, internal applications, and apis.
* administer responsible portions of liberty's microsoft azure subscription: resource and subscription organization, role\-based access control through entra id, cost management and budget monitoring, tagging and naming standards, and platform\-level security configuration.
* own the azure infrastructure supporting liberty os and liberty aura — provisioning, configuration, monitoring, patching, and capacity planning for the app services, databases, key vaults, and supporting resources those platforms depend on.
* lead the decommissioning of legacy systems and databases: plan and execute data migration and archival, confirm records\-retention obligations are satisfied before shutdown, retire orphaned azure resources, and document what was retired and where the data now lives.

**ai\-enabled development*** design, build, and maintain internal software applications and automations using ai\-assisted development tools and coding agents as a primary part of the development workflow.
* translate business and operational needs from bi, operations, and other liberty teams into working internal tools, integrations, and automations.
* apply sound software engineering practice — code review, version control, testing, and documentation — to everything shipped, regardless of how much of it was ai\-assisted.
* evaluate and responsibly adopt new ai coding tools and workflows, and share practices that raise the team’s overall development speed and quality.
* build and maintain integrations between the data warehouse and internal business applications.
* work within liberty’s data handling, security, and compliance guardrails when building anything that touches production, sensitive, or regulated data.

**required qualifications**

* 6\+ years of experience administering sql server or a comparable relational database platform in a production environment.
* hands\-on experience building and maintaining etl/elt pipelines and data warehouse or data mart architectures.
* hands\-on experience administering a microsoft azure subscription: resource and subscription organization, role\-based access control (entra id), cost management, and platform security configuration.
* strong sql skills, including query optimization, indexing strategy, and performance troubleshooting.
* practical experience building software using modern ai coding assistants or agents (for example, claude code, github copilot, or cursor) as part of a real development workflow, not just casual use.
* working proficiency in at least one modern programming language (for example, python, c\#, or javascript/typescript) for building internal tools and automations.
* familiarity with version control (git) and standard software development lifecycle practices.
* strong troubleshooting skills and comfort owning a system end to end, from data ingestion through the reports and applications built on top of it.
* experience migrating off and decommissioning legacy systems or databases, including data migration, archival, and retention\-compliant shutdown.
* clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical stakeholders.

**preferred qualifications**

* experience with azure sql managed instance or another cloud data platform.
* experience with infrastructure\-as\-code (bicep, arm, or terraform) and azure cost management or finops practices.
* experience with tableau or another modern bi/reporting tool, as a data publisher or consumer.
* experience in insurance, brokerage, or financial services, or with agency management systems such as applied epic or ams360\.
* experience building or integrating with mcp (model context protocol) servers or similar agentic/ai tool\-calling architectures.
* exposure to data governance or regulatory compliance requirements relevant to insurance and financial data.
* experience mentoring other developers on ai\-assisted development practices.

**tools \& technologies**

**database \& warehouse**

  

sql server, azure sql managed instance, t\-sql, etl/elt integration tooling

 **bi \& reporting**

  

tableau and internal dashboarding tools

 **development**

  

python, c\#/.net or javascript/typescript, git/github

 **ai\-enabled development**

  

claude code, github copilot, or comparable ai coding assistants and agent frameworks

 **cloud \& infrastructure**

  

microsoft azure subscription administration (app services, key vault, entra id, azure monitor, cost management, azure policy); infrastructure\-as\-code tooling (bicep, arm, or terraform)

  

***promoting peace of mind for all***
at liberty, we take great care to promote peace of mind for all. we create a safe space to find your joy of being as your most authentic self. being uniquely you, with your unique experiences and ideas, we will continue to strengthen our company as we grow together.
habu has nothing to do with age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, or ethnicity. we pursue people who value: integrity, excellence, caring, kindness, fairness, teamwork, good feelings, and fun! liberty empowers our team with tools and knowledge to support the purposeful spread of positive energy, kindness, and good feelings with others.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**a little about:**



oats overnight is on a mission to build a generational cpg brand. since 2016, our high\-protein, drinkable oatmeal has reached over a million customers through direct\-to\-consumer, and we're now scaling with all major nationwide retail and club partners. our goal: become a household brand by leveraging speed, storytelling, and strategy.



we are vertically integrated: we develop, manufacture, and fulfill everything in\-house. this operational control allows us to engage customers directly into the r\&d process, an initiative where we were first\-to\-market in cpg. it also makes our brand tangible and real: our factory, our team, and our product pipeline are all part of the narrative.



this is an exciting stage \- we are emerging as a significant omni\-channel brand and launching new products to capture significant market share across verticals. we want you to help us get there.



every teammate here has equity because we're building something big, and everyone plays an important role. if you're excited about building a brand that does things differently, this is that opportunity.


**what's the job**



data is becoming a core part of how oats overnight operates. our data team builds the infrastructure, models, analytics, and ai\-powered tools that help teams across the company make better and faster decisions.



we're looking for a senior data engineer to become our first dedicated data engineering hire and second member of the data team. you'll report directly to the director of analytics, and together you'll build and evolve the data platform that powers analytics, ai, internal tooling, and operational workflows across oats overnight. you'll work closely together to set the technical direction for data, prioritize the highest\-impact opportunities, and build the foundation for how the company uses data as we scale.



this is a broad, high\-ownership role. your primary responsibility is data engineering: building pipelines, designing reliable data models, improving our data platform, and making high\-quality data available throughout the organization. but we're intentionally a lean team, so you'll also work directly with engineering and occasionally flex into analytics, bi, data science, and automation when those are the highest\-impact problems to solve.



we're looking for a technical builder who enjoys working across the stack, thrives in ambiguity, and wants significant ownership over how a growing company uses data.


**what you'll be doing, stop scanning and read this part**


**build \& own our data platform**


* **own our data pipelines end to end.** design, build, and operate reliable pipelines across internal systems, apis, applications, and third\-party platforms, including our airflow and dbt infrastructure.
* **build integrations and trusted data models.** develop durable integrations and create clean, scalable, well\-documented source\-of\-truth datasets for analytics, operational workflows, and downstream applications.
* **improve reliability and quality.** establish testing, monitoring, observability, and alerting that make our data platform dependable as the company scales.


**build for ai \& partner with engineering**


* **build the data foundation for ai.** make well\-defined, trustworthy data available to our internal ai analytics agents and other ai\-powered workflows.
* **partner closely with engineering.** support application data, integrations, apis, event instrumentation, and other data infrastructure needs across our software and operational systems.
* **build beyond the warehouse.** develop lightweight apis, services, automations, and internal tools when the right solution extends beyond a traditional data pipeline, using ai coding tools to accelerate development.


**establish how we do data engineering**


* **set data engineering standards.** establish best practices across architecture, modeling, testing, ci/cd, code review, documentation, governance, and reliability.
* **continuously improve our platform.** simplify architecture, reduce technical debt, eliminate manual processes, and improve developer velocity.
* **build pragmatically for scale.** make technical and architectural decisions that balance what the business needs today with where our data platform needs to go.


**solve problems across the business**


* **partner directly with the business.** work with teams across oats overnight to understand their problems and translate them into scalable technical and data solutions.
* **f****lex beyond data engineering when needed.** build a looker/hex model, investigate a business question, prototype a forecasting model, automate an operational process, or tackle another high\-impact problem when needed.
* **own the outcome.** stay close to how your work is actually used \- we care about whether the solution solves the problem, not just whether the pipeline ran successfully.
* other duties as assigned


**what you've done and who you are**


* 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, software engineering with a data focus, or a related technical role. we're also open to strong analytics engineers looking to grow further into data engineering and infrastructure ownership.
* strong proficiency in python and sql, with experience writing production\-quality code and building etl/elt pipelines.
* experience with modern data tooling, including airflow and/or dbt, and a cloud data warehouse such as snowflake, bigquery, or redshift.
* experience building data pipelines and integrations across apis, databases, and third\-party systems.
* strong understanding of data modeling and warehouse design, including building reliable, reusable source\-of\-truth datasets.
* experience using coding agents and ai\-assisted development tools as part of your engineering workflow.
* someone that can partner and influence at all different levels
* ability to handle multiple priorities and navigate in a fast moving environment
* a relentless drive to get things done.
* flexible, willing, and quick to learn new processes, new technology, and new ways of thinking.


**nice to have**


* experience as an early data hire or building significant parts of a data platform from the ground up.
* deep production experience with snowflake, dbt, airflow, looker, and/or hex.
* experience building ai/llm data infrastructure, internal apis, backend services, or internal tools.
* experience with business analytics, with a track record of translating data, models, and technical insights into actionable business decisions.
* experience working with data across subscription e\-commerce, manufacturing, supply chain, marketing, finance, or operations.


**why you might like working here**


* this is going to be fun.
* casual, friendly culture. we're serious about what we do but we don't take ourselves too seriously.
* every employee has equity
* high growth potential with opportunities to expand
* free oatmeal. it's very good.


**why you might not like working here**


* it's not a cushy job, the bar is high
* we are growing quickly, and have a fast\-paced work environment.


**our core values**


* **ownership \-** we are all owners. we show up with passion and accountability in everything we do. if something's broken, fix it or call it out.
* **rational \-** how we decide matters. we focus on what we can control and make high\-quality decisions repeatedly.
* **iterative \-** we challenge the status quo and improve constantly. when data or situations change, we adapt.
* **curiosity \-** we ask questions, even when it's uncomfortable. learning and leading go hand in hand.


**physical demands**


* prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* you must be able to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ada, fmla, and other federal, state, and local standards
* you must be able to maintain regular, punctual attendance consistent with the ada, fmla, and other federal, state, and local standards


**the perks**


* full benefits; medical, dental, vision and 401k
* parental leave
* 4 weeks of paid time off
* weekly pay
* stock options, every employee is an owner
* free, delicious oatmeal


**and last but never least….**



we value people who roll up their sleeves and support their fellow team members. we embrace diversity and encourage equal opportunity every chance we get, and we look forward to learning from people whose backgrounds, skills, and perspectives challenge and enrich our own.



oats overnight provides equal employment opportunities (eeo) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. oats overnight complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities.


equal opportunity employer

title: Data Scientist
description:
**description**
---------------


about weyerhaeuser  

at weyerhaeuser, we are the world’s premier timberland, and forest products company. sustainability is the founding concept of our business, and our values drive every decision to ensure we continue to lead the forestry industry in sustainability practices. and we know about sustainability – we led it in the forestry industry when we planted our first seedling by hand in 1938\. we recognize that our success is dependent on the success of our people. for over 125 years, our weyerhaeuser team has been making a difference in the world – from the seedlings we plant, to the forests and trees we nurture, we ensure every acre is managed with diligence, patience and pride. that’s the weyerhaeuser way.


about the role  

grasp the opportunity to apply data science to the physical world of manufacturing! we are seeking an experienced data scientist to provide technical leadership and passionate about applying machine learning, statistics, experimentation, and optimization techniques to solve complex business problems across manufacturing, operations reliability, supply chain, and product quality domains. we have a large manufacturing presence in north america with lumber, osb, plywood, and engineered lumber products mills in canada and the united states. our weyerhaeuser brand and scale of operations make us a major player in the wood products business. you would be partnering with our manufacturing mills to identify, analyze, and solve complex problems related to production quality, equipment reliability, and preventative maintenance. your work would directly impact operational efficiency, improved product quality, and mill uptime. you will work with historian data, mes systems, machine sensors, vision systems, operational events, and enterprise data to build solutions that directly impact mill performance. you have a high attention to detail, but are good at seeing the big picture, and aren’t afraid to think outside the box, and champion your ideas. you have experience articulating opportunity, as well as creating and successfully managing projects. you are effective at communicating timely and relevant information to business leaders and internal partners.


responsibilities

* partner with manufacturing, reliability, maintenance, quality, and operations teams to understand business problems and translate them into machine learning opportunities.
* analyze large volumes of industrial time\-series, historian, mes, erp, and sensor data to identify patterns, bottlenecks, and root causes.
* establish reusable patterns, standards, and best practices for model development and deployment.
* define success metrics that balance model performance with business outcomes including revenue growth, operational efficiency, customer experience, safety, and risk reduction.
* partner with product managers and operation teams to identify, prioritize, and frame business opportunities that can be solved with scientific framework.
* influence technical direction across multiple programs without direct authority.
* design, execute, and analyze online and offline experiments, including a/b testing, causal inference, and counterfactual analysis, to evaluate the impact of data science solutions on business outcomes.
* design, develop, and evaluate machine learning and deep learning models to solve forecasting, optimization, reliability, anomaly detection, and decision\-support problems.
* design and implement statistical process control methods and anomaly detection techniques to proactively address quality issues in the manufacturing process.
* own the end\-to\-end model lifecycle, including feature engineering, training, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and continuous improvement.
* collaborate with software engineers, ml engineers, and data engineers to productionize models and integrate ai capabilities into business workflows.
* translate ambiguous business problems into scientific approaches and influence stakeholders through data\-driven recommendations.
* develop analytical visualizations and communicate findings through dashboards, notebooks, and presentations that drive business decisions.
* contribute to reusable analytics libraries, feature engineering patterns, and best practices across industrial ai use cases.
**qualifications**
------------------

* 5\+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning and ai solutions in manufacturing, industrial, supply chain, or related domains.
* strong software engineering skills in python and modern ml frameworks.
* expertise in supervised learing, forecasting, optimization, statistical modeling, anomaly detection, model evaluation and experimentation methodologies.
* demonstrated success delivering enterprise\-scale ai products from concept through production.
* experience leading highly ambiguous technical initiatives.
* proven ability to influence technical strategy across multiple teams and organizations.
* experience with experimentation and causal inference methods, including a/b testing, quasi\-experimental designs, and counterfactual analysis.
* experience communicating insights using power bi or python\-based visualization libraries such as plotly and matplotlib.
* experience with modern cloud platforms and data architectures, including aws, azure, snowflake, and mlops, ci/cd, and model lifecycle management.


preferred, not required:

* practical experience with recommendation systems, pricing optimization, and computer vision
* practical experience in forestry services or wood product manufacturing
* experience with industrial internet of things and time\-series manufacturing data


education

* bachelor's or master's degree in data science, computer science, statistics, machine learning, operations research, applied mathematics, or related quantitative discipline.

**what we offer:**

**compensation:** this role is eligible for our annual merit\-increase program, and we are targeting a salary range of $98,811\-148,217 based on your level of skills, qualifications and experience. you will also be eligible for our annual incentive program, which offers a cash bonus targeting 15% of base pay. potential plan funding may range from zero to two times that target.

**benefits:** when you join our team, you and your dependents will be offered coverage under our comprehensive employee benefits plan, which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long\-term disability, and life insurance. we offer a pre\-tax health savings account option which includes a company contribution. other benefit options are also available such as voluntary long\-term care and employee assistance programs. we also support personal volunteerism, sponsor a host of diversity networks, promote mentoring, and provide training and development opportunities to help you chart your path to a fulfilling career.

**retirement:** employees are able to enroll in our company’s 401k plan, which includes a paid company match in addition to our contribution equal to 5% of your eligible pay

**paid time off or vacation:** we provide eligible employees who are scheduled to work 25 hours or more per week with 3\-weeks of paid vacation to use during your first year of employment. in addition, after being employed for six months, eligible employees begin to accrue vacation for future use. we also recognize eleven paid holidays per year, providing a total of 88 holiday hours and paid parental leave for all full\-time employees.

description:
**software engineer iii**

 **about the firm**

***firm mission***

***“achieving client success through research and technology”***


los angeles capital, the “firm”, is a global equity manager of assets for leading institutions around the world. the firm is recognized as a pioneer in dynamic equity management, utilizing proprietary technology to engineer equity portfolios that adapt to today’s equity market. the firm’s senior investment professionals have worked together for three decades developing models for measuring and forecasting return and risk of global equity securities. the firm manages approximately $40\.1 billion as of december 31, 2025, across a wide variety of public equity strategies designed to meet institutional client return and risk objectives. the firm has been ranked for seven years in a row by pensions and investments as one of the “best places to work in money management.” the firm’s working environment places a strong focus on teamwork and values work\-life balance. the firm offers a competitive compensation package that includes health care plans, 401(k), and top\-tier benefits. the firm is 100% employee\-owned through a holding company structure and seeks to retain and motivate employees’ long term. los angeles capital firmly believes the quality and commitment of the individuals are vital to the success of the firm, ensuring that client expectations are exceeded.

**position overview**


reporting to the director in the quantitative investment platform (qip) team within research, the software engineer will help design, build, and maintain the python applications, services, and tooling that power the firm’s investment platform. as a senior engineer, this person will write production code — apis, domain logic, automation, and supporting libraries — with a strong emphasis on clean, well\-tested, maintainable software. this is a strong fit for someone with real depth in software engineering that wants to develop critical infrastructure, model, and data handling code in a quantitative investment firm.

 **key job responsibilities**

* design, build, and maintain python applications and services that support the firm’s research and investment process
* write clean, well\-tested, maintainable code following team standards: type hints throughout, small focused functions, and clear naming
* build and consume internal apis (e.g., fastapi) and well\-modeled domain libraries (e.g., pydantic), with attention to clear interfaces and separation of concerns
* participate actively in code review, both giving and receiving feedback, as a core part of how the team ships software
* contribute to the team’s automated test suites and help keep them fast, reliable, and meaningful
* help maintain and improve ci/cd pipelines (github actions) so that changes ship safely and frequently
* integrate the software you build with the firm’s data platform (snowflake) and orchestration (prefect) where the work calls for it
* write and keep current the technical documentation and runbooks for the components you own
* collaborate with quantitative researchers and fellow engineers to turn requirements into reliable, well\-designed software
* participate in agile team practices including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and estimation
* continuously sharpen your engineering practice and take on increasing scope and ownership as you grow
* build and extend ai\-assisted tooling for the research and engineering workflow, including mcp servers and agent integrations (e.g., claude, anthropic api) that expose internal data and services to llm\-based assistant/agent.
**skills and knowledge required**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, mathematics, statistics, or equivalent professional experience
* at least 5 years of hands\-on professional experience writing production software
* solid proficiency in python, including a working understanding of idiomatic, well\-structured code
* familiarity with writing automated tests and an understanding of why testing matters.
* familiarity with version control in git, including branching and the pull\-request / code\-review workflow
* understanding of core software engineering fundamentals: data structures, clean code, modular design, and debugging
* working proficiency in sql
* demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly and a genuine eagerness to do so
* clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work effectively on a collaborative team
* experience or strong interest in building with llms: mcp server development, agentic workflows, and frameworks such as langchain/langgraph and langsmith for tracing and evaluation
**skills and knowledge desired**

* exposure to test\-driven development and an interest in software craftsmanship (e.g., clean code, refactoring, working effectively with legacy code)
* experience building web apis, ideally with fastapi or a similar framework
* experience with data modeling and validation libraries such as pydantic
* exposure to ci/cd pipelines (e.g., github actions) and modern deployment practices
* familiarity with azure or another major cloud provider, and with containerization (docker)
* exposure to a cloud data warehouse (ideally snowflake) and workflow orchestration (prefect, dagster, airflow)
* interest in financial markets, quantitative investing, or financial/market data
 **this is a hybrid position based in los angeles, ca which requires weekly attendance.**

title: Sr. Software Engineer - CloudOps
description:
**sr. software engineer \- cloudops**
=====================================


location los angeles, california, 90007 category technology jr202639288 onsite
  
sr. software engineer \- cloudops
**about clublabs**


clublabs is the digital acceleration team for the automobile club of southern california (aaa). we build intuitive customer experiences across the organization's insurance, membership, financial, emergency roadside, and travel services \- a team of engineers, designers, researchers, and product managers delivering maximum value to our members and business for a smarter future.


**the role**


we are seeking an ambitious, empathic, and collaborative senior software engineer (cloudops) to make an impact for the millions of members that auto club enterprises serves. cloudops is an engineering enablement and support function: your mission is to make other engineering teams faster, safer, and more self\-sufficient \- and to continuously advance how that support is delivered, from manual effort toward automation and ai\-driven self\-service wherever it makes sense. the ideal candidate is a strong collaborator, a fast self\-learner, and an excellent problem solver who can evaluate requirements and take complex, ambiguous problems and redefine, re\-scope, and transform them into simple, secure solutions. this is a senior individual\-contributor role with technical leadership expectations: you'll lead projects end to end, drive technical decisions, and move work forward across teams independently. security is a first\-class outcome in everything you build and operate. you bring real depth in cloud engineering fundamentals and use ai\-assisted tooling to work faster and at greater scale, while retaining the judgment to review, validate, and stand behind every change. this role enhances the technical agility, security posture, and operational resilience of clublabs' new product lines.


**requirements**


* 5\+ years of experience in one or more programming languages (python, typescript/javascript, c\#, java, etc.).
* 5\+ years of professional experience in the design, development, and operation of enterprise cloud solutions, including production infrastructure and ci/cd.
* strong security engineering background \- secure\-by\-design practices, iam and least\-privilege, networking (vpc design, segmentation, firewalls/security groups, tls), secrets and key management, data protection, and remediation of security findings in a cloud environment. security is central to this role, not an add\-on.
**qualifications**


* computer science fundamentals in object\-oriented principles, algorithms, problem solving, and complexity analysis.
* practical experience with cloud methodologies (iaas, paas, saas), automation, orchestration, and industry\-leading cloud vendor offerings.
* solid experience implementing and operating high performance, high availability, reliable, and secure systems.
* experience designing and developing solutions using aws services such as: lambda, api gateway, s3, dynamodb, rds, kms, kinesis, route 53, iam, codebuild, codepipeline, and other managed services.
* experience with cloud automation and iac tools such as aws cloudformation, aws cdk, terraform, etc.
* track record of reducing operational toil by moving beyond one\-off automation toward guardrailed, ai\-driven self\-service \- where iac is the trusted substrate and ai\-assisted interfaces let users and agents safely resolve their own requests.
* proficiency using ai\-assisted engineering tools (e.g., claude code, amazon q, copilot) to accelerate development, troubleshooting, and automation \- with the depth to review ai\-generated output critically and understand why a change is correct before shipping it.
* comfort operating in ambiguity \- making pragmatic decisions and moving work forward without full clarity, learning through delivery rather than waiting for a perfect spec.
* familiarity with genai/agent services (amazon bedrock, strands, agentcore, or comparable) and the fundamentals of securing model access (iam, kms) and managing cost and quotas \- preferred.
* experience with multi\-account aws governance (control tower / landing zone accelerator) preferred.
* strong written and communication skills.
* experience in hybrid on\-prem and cloud implementation and integration preferred.
* good understanding of web and api development and implementation concepts.
* experience working with serverless and container technologies.
* experience with agile methodologies.
**responsibilities**


* enable engineering teams \- provide the platforms, tooling, guardrails, and support that let them ship faster and more safely, reducing their dependence on manual, ticket\-driven help.
* advance the support model up the automation curve \- progress manual, repetitive support toward automation and ai\-driven self\-service, so common requests resolve themselves with the right approvals and controls in place.

title: Machine Learning Engineer 5
description:
machine learning engineer 5
do you love building and pioneering in the ai and technology space? do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast\-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment? at capital one, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors who love to solve real problems and meet real customer needs. we are seeking **machine learning engineers** who are passionate about leveraging cutting\-edge open source frameworks, advanced algorithms, and emerging technologies to join our team. as a machine learning engineer, you’ll have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving major ai transformations and scaling production models across capital one.

 **what you’ll do:**

* the mle role overlaps with many disciplines, such as ops, modeling, and data engineering. in this role, you'll be expected to perform many ml engineering activities, including one or more of the following:
* design, build, and/or deliver ml models and components that solve real\-world business problems, while working in collaboration with the product and data science teams
* build and scale massive multi\-tenant platforms that enable running large footprint ml model training and/or serving at scale
* inform your ml infrastructure decisions using your understanding of ml modeling techniques and issues, including choice of model, data, and feature selection, model training, hyperparameter tuning, dimensionality, bias/variance, and validation)
* solve complex problems by writing and testing application code, developing and validating ml models, and automating tests and deployment
* collaborate as part of a cross\-functional agile team to create and enhance software that enables state\-of\-the\-art big data and ml applications
* retrain, maintain, and monitor models in production
* leverage or build cloud\-based architectures, technologies, and/or platforms to deliver optimized ml models at scale.
* construct optimized data pipelines to feed ml models
* leverage continuous integration and continuous deployment best practices, including test automation and monitoring, to ensure successful deployment of ml models and application code
* ensure all code is well\-managed to reduce vulnerabilities, models are well\-governed from a risk perspective, and the ml follows best practices in responsible and explainable ai
* use programming languages like python, scala, or java

 **basic qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree or higher in computer science, machine learning or a related quantitative field (statistics, economics, operations research, analytics, mathematics, engineering)
* at least 6 years of experience programming with python, java, golang, or c\+\+
* at least 6 years of machine learning experience using industry standard frameworks pytorch or tensorflow and libraries (pandas, numpy, scikit\-learn)
* at least 6 years of experience using and operating large scale distributed systems (spark, ray) to prepare ai or machine learning data
* at least 4 years of experience deploying and operating machine learning solutions in production and operating production services in the cloud (aws, gcp, azure) and using kubernetes to manage large scale containerized machine learning software systems

 **preferred qualifications:**

* master's or doctoral degree in computer science, electrical engineering, mathematics, or related field
* 5\+ years of experience optimizing ml algorithms, configurations, and infrastructure
* 5\+ years of experience following software development best practices including source control, testing, code reviews, ci/cd, etc.
* 5\+ years of experience building resilient software solutions with pre\-production testing, advanced deployment techniques (one\-box, blue/green, gradual dial\-up), monitoring, alarms, and preparing incident response plans
* 5\+ years of experience working with machine learning techniques (supervised, semi\-supervised, and unsupervised, reinforcement learning, etc.) model types (regression, classification, clustering, etc.), model architectures (rnns, cnns, lstms, transformers), training concepts (loss function, hyperparameters, regularization), and how to evaluate model accuracy and diagnose and address common issues (underfitting, overfitting)
* 5\+ years of experience designing, implementing, and scaling production\-ready data pipelines for training and evaluating ml models
* ml industry impact through conference presentations, papers, blog posts, open source contributions, or patents
* ability to communicate complex technical and machine learning concepts clearly to a variety of audiences

* at least 2 years of experience with public cloud platforms (aws, gcp, azure), cloud\-based productivity tools, or virtualization technologies

* 7\+ years of experience coding with more than two of the following: nodejs, javascript, typescript, angular, html, css, java, sql, python

* 3\+ years of experience with aws, gcp, azure, or cloud\-based productivity tools or virtualization technologies
* 4\+ years of experience contributing to open source frameworks
* 4\+ years of experience creating synchronous and asynchronous apis
* 3\+ years of experience with ci/cd pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automated testing frameworks
* 3\+ years of experience using git\-based version\-control systems (e.g., git, github, bitbucket)
* 3\+ years of experience troubleshooting technical issues within cloud environments
* 1\+ year of experience mentoring engineers and driving professional development within technical teams
* 1\+ year of experience leveraging observability to identify and optimize performance bottlenecks in distributed systems

* experience establishing and enforcing coding standards and design patterns across teams
* experience leveraging spec\-driven development (sdd)
