title: Software Data Engineer
description:
**about the role \& team**


do you remember seeing trailers for *the devil wears prada 2* earlier this summer? what about digital spots for a cruise on the disney wish? or the california adventure food and wine festival? if you did, it was likely because of the detailed planning and execution of the walt disney company’s enterprise media and marketing team…and if you didn’t – it’s probably because our targeting is *that good*.

  

we are looking for a **data** **engineer** to join the performance marketing arm of this media team. we are an integrated, cross\-functional team of marketers, software engineers, data scientists, and analysts who help the media team execute highly data\-driven marketing campaigns and tactics.

  

as a data engineer, you will help expand our technology portfolio of innovative campaign planning tools, complex data science workflows, and elegant web applications that blend the art of advertising with the science of data\-backed insights.

  

this role is unique – our team is embedded **directly** within the disney media team. we're aligned, mission\-driven, and free to move fast and innovate towards our goals. you'll tackle the challenges of executing and optimizing precise paid media strategies, using the latest technologies and tools. if you're excited about this, please get in touch – we'd love to hear from you!

 **what you will do**

* contribute to the development of the suite of tools used by the performance marketing group
* drive data engineering, data modeling, and architectural standards within the team; uphold standards and rigor around pipeline development, observability, and documentation
* create and manage end\-to\-end data pipelines – from source system to end consumer teams, applications, and users
* collaborate with the broader team of media/marketing experts to rapidly iterate from prototypes to high\-quality, production pipelines and applications
* implement quality controls, monitoring, and other safeguards to ensure optimizations are accurately and safely applied to in\-flight ad campaigns and key business metrics are always presented accurately
 **required qualifications \& skills**

* bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, software engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* 3\+ years of experience designing and delivering backend architectures in a production environment, with a strong understanding of design patterns and best practices.
* strong opinions on how to best use ai/llms in the software development process; ability to quickly discern hype from value in the quickly evolving ai landscape (and an equal ability to put it into practice)
* experience with spark and sql; experience building simple and maintainable data pipelines on scaled data platforms
* ability to dive deep into any technical component
* experience working in a fast\-paced environment with cross\-functional teams to translate business needs into reality\-based requirements
 **preferred qualifications**

* experience working effectively with data science teams
* specific experience with our stack: spark, python, databricks/snowflake, aws, terraform
* knowledge of media buying and ad platforms including dmps, google ads, facebook/instagram, innovid, liveramp and dsps (google display video, the trade desk, yahoo)
  


the hiring range for this remote position in burbank, ca is $106,900\.00 \- $143,300\.00 per year, which factors in various geographic regions. the base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. a bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
we take play seriously. we’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. at hasbro and wizards of the coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. this is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.


at wizards of the coast, we connect people around the world through play and imagination. from our genre\-defining games like magic: the gathering® and dungeons \& dragons® to our growing multiverse, we continue to innovate and build new ways to foster friendship and connection. that’s where you come in!


we are looking for a senior software engineer to join our business systems engineering (bse) organization. we build the platform and applications that power the creation and production of magic: the gathering®, dungeons \& dragons®, and duel masters®. these products drive over $2 billion in annual revenue and are beloved by millions of players worldwide. the systems we build are what make that work possible.


this is a role with high impact and real stakes. you'll set technical direction, shape engineering culture, and lead others while staying hands\-on. you'll work on the cutting edge of ai\-driven software development, pairing technical excellence and engineering discipline with ai\-accelerated delivery ensuring quality, reliability, and long\-term maintainability. we're on a journey to make history, and we want you to help lead it!


if you're motivated by ownership, care deeply about the craft, and want to build something that matters — join the party.


### **what you'll do:**


* design and develop services and applications on aws that are core to our product creation platform.
* influence and champion and engineering standards across the org, resulting in effective system design at both the application and service level.
* leverage and enhance our ai\-assisted development tooling continuously improving the practices, review standards, and quality gates that keep ai\-accelerated delivery reliable and maintainable.
* own technical decisions end\-to\-end: assess tradeoffs, align partners, drive execution, and follow through without waiting to be asked.
* translate business challenges into well\-designed, scalable software solutions in partnership with product owners and cross\-functional partners.
* influence and build up your teammates through technical direction, and code and design reviews, supporting their growth and career development.

### **what you'll bring:**


* 8\+ years of software engineering experience, with 2\+ years in a lead, staff, or senior\+ capacity.
* proven track record building and operating production\-grade enterprise software. deep understanding of application and distributed system design and architecture patterns.
* hands\-on experience with ai\-assisted development workflows and the judgment to critically evaluate ai\-generated code against production quality standards.
* proficiency in c\#/.net, java, go or comparable languages, aws, docker/ecs/eks), ci/cd pipelines, rest apis, event\-driven systems, and relational database design.
* a history of influencing engineers through pairing, feedback, and driving technical excellence among your team.
* a strong sense of ownership and the communication skills to drive outcomes across technical and non\-technical partners.
* bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or equivalent professional experience.

### **nice to have:**


* experience with react.js or other popular frontend frameworks.
* familiarity with event streaming platforms (e.g., kafka, aws sns/sqs).
* experience with kubernetes, terraform, or infrastructure\-as\-code practices.
* curiosity about or knowledge of wizards brands.

title: Machine Learning Scientist III - Ads + Search & Recommendations
description:
**salary range:** $194,040 \- $206,167 per year. individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. compensation details listed in this posting reflect the annual base salary only and do not include equity.
  
  

**who we are:**  

the ads \+ search and recommendations machine learning (ml) team at wayfair is at the forefront of designing and implementing algorithms that define our global search experience. using cutting\-edge machine learning approaches, including deep sequence models, embeddings and multi\-modal technologies, we aim to deliver a personalized and compelling experience for over 22 million active customers. our mission is to make the user experience intuitive and efficient, helping customers discover exactly what they need in a vast and diverse product catalog.
  
  

wayfair’s advertising business is rapidly expanding, adding hundreds of millions of dollars in profits to wayfair. we are building sponsored products, display \& video ad offerings that cater to a variety of advertiser goals while showing highly relevant and engaging ads to millions of customers. we are evolving our ads platform to empower advertisers across all sophistication levels to grow their business on wayfair at a strong, positive roi and are leveraging state of the art machine learning techniques.
  
  

wayfair is an online retail platform with the mission to enable everyone to live in a home they love. to do this, wayfair builds and leverages cutting\-edge machine learning and ai products and we are looking for talented individuals to join us. you will join the customer technology \- search \& recommendations org within its advertising footprint and ranking team working on candidate generation and retrieval systems. you will be part of a cross\-functional, collaborative team driving development of world\-class ml systems that drive real\-world impact.
  
  

**here are some of the key projects our team works on:**  

\*
  
  

**candidate generation/retrieval:** selecting the right subset of products for our final scoring layers from our entire catalog efficiently through deep understanding of our product catalog and our customers at extreme scale using low latency situations across multiple types of candidate generators and retrieval stages. this includes generative retrieval, lightweight l1 ranking, item\-to\-item methods (such as gcnns), and many more!
  
\*
  
  

**scoring:** producing personalized scores like pctr and pcvr for downstream ranking and footprint systems through state\-of\-the\-art ml methods including deep learning, sequence transformers and llms (\[1] wayseq)
  
\*
  
  

**ranking optimization:** ordering advertising products on the page given personalization, relevance and other factors (\[2] profit aware ad ranking)
  
\*
  
  

**footprint:** determining where advertising goes on our website by optimizing the tradeoff between ad revenue and customer relevance (\[3] ad allocation at scale)
  
  

**what you’ll do:**  

\*
  
  

**develop robust retrieval systems:** build and optimize candidate generation pipelines that surface high\-quality, personalized product recommendations at scale.
  
\*
  
  

**leverage user and product signals:** apply deep learning and representation learning to model user preferences, product attributes, and contextual signals for better recommendation performance.
  
\*
  
  

**innovate with cutting\-edge techniques:** explore sequence modeling, embeddings, and multi\-modal modeling to drive the next generation of recommender systems.
  
\*
  
  

**collaborate cross\-functionally:** partner with product managers, engineers, and data scientists to align recommendation strategies with business objectives and user needs.
  
\*
  
  

**tackle recommendation\-specific challenges:** solve key issues such as the cold\-start problem, data sparsity, product compatibility and seasonality in dynamic environments.
  
\*
  
  

**advance the ml community at wayfair:** contribute to internal knowledge sharing, author technical documentation, and represent wayfair at top ml conferences like ads kdd, neurips and recsys.
  
  

**you are a fit if you have:**  

\*
  
  

minimum 2\+ years of experience with phd, or 4\+ years of industry experience with ms, or 6\+ years of experience with a bs in a quantitative stem field.
  
\*
  
  

1\+ years of industry experience as an ml engineer, applied scientist, or research scientist, with a proven track record of delivering ml projects autonomously in recommendations, search, or ranking.
  
\*
  
  

expertise in recommendation systems, including candidate generation, ranking algorithms, and user\-item modeling.
  
\*
  
  

deep understanding of techniques like sequence modeling, gcnns, and/or embedding\-based personalization.
  
\*
  
  

experience with end\-to\-end project ownership, including collaboration with business partners and strong written and verbal communication skills.
  
\*
  
  

strong proficiency in python for building and deploying ml\-driven recommendation systems.
  
\*
  
  

experience deploying machine learning models in production environments, with a focus on cloud\-based solutions such as gcp (bigquery, gcs, vertex ai, composer), as well as workflow orchestration tools like airflow, model tracking using mlflow, and containerization technologies like docker.
  
  

**why you’ll love wayfair:**  

* time off:
* paid holidays
* paid time off (pto)
* health \& wellness:
* full health benefits (medical, dental, vision, hsa/fsa)
* life insurance
* disability protection (short term \& long term disability)
* global wellbeing: gym/fitness discounts (including us peloton, global classpass, and various regional gym memberships)
* mental health support (global mental health, global wayhealthy recordings)
* caregiver services
* financial growth \& security:
* 401k matching (employee matching program)
* tuition reimbursement
* financial health education (knowledge of financial education \- kofe)
* tax advantaged accounts
* family support:
* family planning support
* parental leave
* global surrogacy \& adoption policy
* professional development \& recognition:
* rewards \& recognition
* global employee anniversary awards
* paid volunteer work
* unique perks:
* employee discount
* u.s. bluebikes membership
* global pod outings
* work/life balance:
* emphasizing a supportive \& flexible work environment that encourages a balance between personal and professional commitments


if you don’t meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. we’re looking for strong team players who can learn, grow, and make an impact.
  
  

this is a hybrid position located in seattle, wa. the team is in\-office tuesday\-thursday and remote on monday and friday.

our economics \& pricing team needs an additional l2 machine learning scientist to accelerate development of production ml models that inform product\-level prices and margins. this role will own end\-to\-end model design, experimentation, and deployment for high\-impact pricing use cases, replacing legacy binning frameworks and improving contribution margin at scale. the hire is critical to support growing project demand across pricing, promotion, and assortment decisions.

title: Software Development Engineer (Mid-Level / SDE)- Hybrid
description:
zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. our work helps law firms operate more efficiently and helps the injured people they serve access settlement funds more quickly and accurately. we are looking for engineers who want to build the systems that make complex, data\-heavy products work at scale.


we are looking for a software development engineer to join our team, building the next generation of applications for the legal industry. after several years of high growth, zipliens has become a leader in lien resolution, a process required in most personal injury settlements. the software we build supports that work, giving it clear, real\-world impact beyond the technical challenges.


we're scaling engineering significantly this year. you'd be joining a codebase with established patterns and helping extend those patterns as the team grows several times over. you'll have context available rather than a blank slate, and senior engineers on hand when a decision warrants one.


over the coming year, we're building large\-scale data processing, smarter automation of staff workflows, ml/llm systems that extract structure from medical records and lien correspondence, and customer\-facing experiences that make the lien process more transparent. in this role, you'll work across our react and python/django stack: building features, resolving issues, and contributing to system improvements alongside product, operations, and your fellow engineers.


we're hiring for this role at two levels. the difference is scope and independence — how large a piece of work you carry, and how much of it you shepherd through review and deployment on your own — not the kind of work you'd do.


we also build with ai as a first\-class part of the workflow: agentic coding tools, plus internal skills and harnesses we've written ourselves. not autocomplete. you'd be expected to use them well and to improve them.

 **requirements**  


responsibilities:* build and maintain features across our python/django backend and react frontend, writing code that is clean, readable, and consistent with our team's conventions.
* develop and ship features, shepherding your own work from first commit through review, qa, and deployment. how much support you get there depends on where you land; the expectation of ownership doesn't change.
* operate what you build: troubleshoot production issues, debug your services in aws, and follow security practices appropriate to sensitive legal and medical data.
* build and maintain backend services and data processing workflows over large datasets, automating what's currently manual.
* work with product and operations to turn acceptance criteria into features our staff and clients actually use — asking questions where they're unclear, and pushing back where they're wrong.
* work with internal stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* contribute to architecture and scalability improvements under the guidance of senior engineers.
* participate in code reviews, both giving thoughtful feedback and acting on it.


qualifications:* 2\+ years of software development experience building and maintaining systems in production.
* working experience with python/django (preferred) or a comparable framework (node.js, rails, laravel).
* working proficiency in react.
* working sql and postgresql, including writing and reasoning about queries against large tables.
* hands\-on aws experience — eks/ec2, rds, s3, and queueing (sqs or similar). you should understand the infrastructure your services run on, not treat it as someone else's problem.
* proficiency in at least one technical area and a functional understanding of the applications your team owns.
* strong problem\-solving skills and a willingness to take on unfamiliar work.
* clear written and verbal communication; you'll be explaining technical constraints to non\-technical stakeholders.


nice to have:* experience using or experimenting with agentic coding tools, and interest in building tooling around them.
* hands\-on experience with llm or ml features, whether in production or through prototypes and experimentation: prompting, evaluation, and understanding how they fail.
* experience with document processing or extraction from unstructured data.
* experience integrating third\-party or partner apis, especially where the data is inconsistent, and the counterparty's documentation isn't solid.
* experience handling sensitive data such as phi, or working under hipaa\-style requirements.
* familiarity with kubernetes. we have an sre who owns the cluster; you won't be running it, but you'll be deploying to it and debugging your services in it.

  

**benefits**  


benefits* private health care plan (medical, dental \& vision)
* company hsa contributions for hdhp participants
* flexible spending accounts (health \& dependent care)
* company\-paid short\-term disability coverage
* voluntary long\-term disability, life, ad\&d, and supplemental coverage options
* 401(k) plan with company match
* paid time off (vacation, sick time \& 10 paid holidays)
* parental leave

title: Software Engineer II
description:
### **description**

 **about proedge**
proedge dental water labs is a team of selfless builders. by putting our focus on the success of customers, we've created a healthy, quickly\-growing, dynamic company. our \~50 team has taken on a significant challenge: transform compliance in the dental practice—an often distinct pain for our customers—into a culture of shared purpose for the safety of patients and staff. by building trust and developing value\-based solutions, we've created an emerging brand in dental.
  

  

because of that, "good work" is the floor here. what we're building takes people who care more about the mission than the credit, who tell the truth before it's comfortable, and who would rather be stretched by real responsibility than protected from it.
  

  

**our values**
* we build trust—by speaking candidly, doing what we say, and owning our mistakes.
* we serve the team above ourselves—by choosing the mission over comfort, clarifying expectations, and engaging in feedback.
* we delight our customers—by taking ownership of their experience, delivering quality they can count on, and treating every customer as valuable.
* we create clarity—by making the goal plain, speaking up when we don't know, and closing the loop when clarity is at risk.
* we improve—by driving our own growth, fixing the root, and making the better way repeatable.


  

**the software engineer ii opportunity**
thousands of dental practices, from single offices to the largest dental groups in the country, use proedge's compliance platform to test their waterlines and sterilizers, see their results, and prove to inspectors that patients are safe. our lab runs the tests. the platform is how the results reach the practice and how compliance is tracked, reminded, and reported. proedge is building its first in\-house development team, and this role exists to make that platform one we own end to end: understood, covered by automated tests, deployed without downtime, and fast to change.
  

  

the team is two people: our head of technology and you. you will build with ai coding agents as the primary way code gets written, and your job is everything the agent cannot own: deciding what to build, specifying it precisely, reading every diff, proving it works, and answering for it in production. when you ship, the lab, our customer success team, and inside sales feel it the same week. a failed test that reaches a practice faster is a patient protected sooner.
  

  

**reports to:** head of technology, kyle crone### **success outcomes**

  

* every change to the platform ships through an automated, zero\-downtime pipeline with one\-click rollback that you and the head of technology can each run alone, within your first 90 days.
* the compliance engine and permissions model are covered by automated tests below the browser, and the end\-to\-end suite is rebuilt in playwright so that independent, trustworthy specs rise every month and the platform runs on one test framework by your six\-month mark.
* inside sales and customer success work from data and reports built for them inside the platform, with a first cut in use within 120 days.
* two legacy modules are migrated to the target stack (typescript, typed sql access, react) under tests with no customer\-visible regression by month six, and the migration order is written down for the modules that follow.
* production is observable and safe: error tracking and alerting live, runbooks for the top failure modes, secrets in a managed store, and no critical or high dependency findings, within 90 days.

  

### **core responsibilities \& role requirements**

 **core responsibilities*** direct ai coding agents (claude code, codex, or whatever is best next quarter) to build, then read every diff, write the tests, and own the result in production. nobody will ask you to prove you can type it by hand; everybody will ask how you know it works.
* migrate the platform module by module from a homegrown javascript front end and an untyped express api to typescript, typed sql access, and react, using the strangler\-fig pattern against live traffic. no big\-bang rewrite, no cutover night.
* write playwright end\-to\-end tests, api permission tests, and sql tests around a compliance engine built from stored procedures and triggers, and keep the merge gate green as the team's source of truth.
* build and own the delivery platform on aws (app runner, amplify hosting, rds, infrastructure as code with cdk): rolling deploys, rollback, monitoring, alerting, and managed secrets.
* ship the reporting, data views, and exports the inside sales and customer success teams need, and sit with the people who use them.
* own the platform's integrations: hubspot for email, netsuite for orders, the api our largest dental\-group customers build on, and the data platform our bi team reports from.
* write it down: decision records, runbooks, and a living map of the system, plus the conventions and context files that let an agent or a new engineer be productive in the repo in minutes.
* share an on\-call rotation with the head of technology once production is instrumented, and be steady when it misbehaves.

**role requirements*** roughly three to six years shipping and operating web software people actually use.
* daily use of ai coding agents as your primary way of building, and the ability to show us your workflow live, including how you review, test, and correct what the agent produces.
* strong sql. you can read and reason about stored procedures, triggers, and views (mysql 8 or postgres), and you have opinions about when logic belongs in the database.
* node.js and typescript on the back end (express or similar); react on the front end.
* you have inherited a codebase you did not write and left it healthier, one tested change at a time.
* aws, docker, and github actions. infrastructure as code (cdk or terraform) is a strong plus.
* playwright or cypress for end\-to\-end testing.
* security instincts: a committed secret, an unpinned dependency, or an endpoint that fails open bothers you until it is fixed.
* writing a director can follow. you will write decision records, runbooks, and short updates.
* comfortable being one of two engineers in a company of fifty: you raise problems early, propose solutions, and can stand up a small initiative on your own.
* able to work in person at our centennial, colorado office.
* not required: dental or compliance knowledge (we will teach you; the lab is down the hall) or a computer science degree.

  

### **additional details**

 **the character we hire for*** **humble** – accurately self\-aware, teachable, and quick to own their misses
* **steward** – owns outcomes, people, and resources as if borrowed
* **discerning** – separates signal from noise and spots the right problem
* **courageous** – acts rightly despite fear, and steps in when it matters
* **transparent** – shares what's real before it becomes a problem

**work location**  

this is a hybrid role — 3 days a week in our centennial office, the rest from wherever you work best. office days are for team alignment, personal development, and collaboration.during onboarding we do require any new team member to be fully onsite, we are deliberate about investing in you and ensuring you are setup for success. then after onboarding you'll move to our hybrid rhythm: remote mondays and fridays, in\-office tuesday through thursday.  

  

**the hiring process**
every hire is one of the most important decisions we make, so we put real time into this — and we'll ask real time from you. the road generally runs: initial interview hiring leader interview cross\-team panel onsite. at the end, you'll get a clear yes or no, communicated directly.
  

  

for this role there is no leetcode and no whiteboard. early in the process you will complete a short practical assessment on hackerrank built from real\-world tasks: a small node service to extend, some sql, and a code review of a pull request. an ai assistant is enabled inside the assessment and you are expected to use it, because that is how you will work here.
  

  

**salary \& benefits**
* salary range of $125,000 to $155,000
* employee medical, dental, \& vision \+ spouse and dependent contributions
* 4% pre\-tax employer match 401k
* accrued pto earning up to 3 weeks annually
* 1 week of paid synchronized organizational rest at year\-end
* 6 additional paid holidays
* employer\-paid short\- and long\-term disability insurance, paid life insurance

**application deadline:** october 31, 2026\.  

proedge is an equal opportunity employer. we're building a team of the right people, and the right people come from all kinds of places and backgrounds. hiring decisions here are made on character, capability, and fit for the work—never on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or anything else unrelated to doing this work with excellence.

title: BI Engineer (Data Analyst)
description:
**about apply**

apply is the agentic customer experience (acx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. we bring together deep domain expertise across retail, cpg, sports, and media with ai\-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn cx vision into commercial reality. we are the partner of choice for brands like arc'teryx, nfl, lululemon, and kraft heinz. for more information, visit applydigital.com.

**the role:**  

apply is seeking a bi engineer / data analyst to support the kraft heinz dxp platform team through and beyond its data platform migration from google cloud platform to azure and snowflake. this role sits at the intersection of business intelligence, data analytics, and data engineering — owning the full path from raw platform data to the insight a stakeholder actually acts on.



you will be responsible for exploring and analyzing data across the platform’s bigquery/snowflake environment, building and maintaining dashboards (primarily in looker studio), and going beyond dashboard delivery to surface the insights, trends, and anomalies driving the business. you’ll work closely with data engineering on the underlying data models and pipelines, and with data governance and martech stakeholders to ensure reporting is accurate, compliant, and trustworthy.



### **responsibilities:**


* design, build, and maintain bi dashboards and reports (looker studio \& power bi) that turn raw platform data into clear, actionable insights for business and marketing stakeholders.

* write and optimize sql across bigquery and snowflake, and build/maintain dbt models to support scalable, governed data marts.
* collaborate on dagster\-orchestrated data pipelines — understanding lineage and dependencies well enough to troubleshoot issues and contribute to data model design, not just consume the output.
* explore and prototype agentic ai and data science solutions (e.g., llm\-powered analysis, automated insight generation, predictive/propensity modeling) to accelerate how the team surfaces and acts on data.
* apply data governance principles in day\-to\-day work: support privacy and retention deletion workflows (onetrust), and ensure pii is handled correctly across crm/martech data integrations (customer.io, twilio segment).
* own the end\-to\-end reporting lifecycle — requirements gathering, data modeling, dashboard build, validation, and stakeholder walkthroughs.
* identify data quality issues and partner with data engineering to resolve root causes rather than patching symptoms downstream.
* stay current on bi and analytics tooling and proactively recommend improvements to the platform’s reporting stack.
### **requirements:**


* bachelor’s degree in data science, computer science, statistics, information systems, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.
* 4\+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or a hybrid analytics engineering role.
* strong sql skills across bigquery and/or snowflake — comfortable with complex queries, ctes, and window functions.
* hands\-on experience building dashboards and reports in looker studio and/or power bi.
* working knowledge of dbt for data modeling and transformation.
* familiarity with pipeline orchestration tools — dagster preferred, airflow or similar also acceptable.
* understanding of data governance and privacy compliance concepts, ideally with exposure to onetrust or a similar consent/privacy management platform.
* experience working with crm/martech data sources such as customer.io, twilio segment, or comparable cdp/esp platforms.
* some hands\-on data engineering skills (python, pipeline debugging, schema design) are a strong plus — you don’t need to be a full\-time data engineer, but you should be comfortable enough to partner closely with one.
* excellent communication skills — able to translate data findings into business insight for non\-technical stakeholders.
* experience supporting a cloud data migration (gcp, azure, or aws) is a plus.
* a curious, insight\-first mindset — comfortable going beyond “build the dashboard that was asked for” to proactively surface what the data is actually saying.
**life at apply**

people are at the core of everything we do at apply. we provide you with modern tools, systems and approaches, value your time, safety, and health, and strive to build a work community where you can thrive and grow. here are a few benefits we offer to support you:
